title: ProngPlacement
description: One resolved prong-placement result: which strategy ran and the real positions it produced. Documents backend/jewelmind/setting/placement.py. Positions are NOT claimed to be professionally correct setting positions (SETTING-GOV-007/010) — for every non-round shape the compatibility status is EXPERIMENTAL. See docs/bible/21-setting/prong-placement-model.md.

strategy.description: RADIAL is the pre-Sprint-19 behaviour, geometrically faithful only for a radially symmetric stone. OUTLINE_CARDINAL samples the stone's real girdle outline. Resolved from the stone's symmetry, never requested via JDL.

positions.description: Prong axis centres in the local XY plane, already pulled inside the girdle by the documented inset.
